Can this somehow be read from the locale files in the angular repo, e.g. here?

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/packages/common/locales/de-AT.ts
https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/master/packages/common/locales/de.ts

I cant really find the difference in here where the other symbol is defined.

Yes I know that - and if you now take the lines from the de-AT.ts file

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/637805a0c90b201f3e258eaeff967d5992d71faf/packages/common/locales/de-AT.ts#L54

and

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/637805a0c90b201f3e258eaeff967d5992d71faf/packages/common/locales/de-AT.ts#L55

You get the following format for currencies get formatted:

`¤ #,##0.00`

According to this method which is getting used by the currency pipe to get the number:

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/637805a0c90b201f3e258eaeff967d5992d71faf/packages/common/src/i18n/locale_data_api.ts#L365

the dot should get replaced by the character used for decimal point.

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/637805a0c90b201f3e258eaeff967d5992d71faf/packages/common/src/i18n/locale_data_api.ts#L351

now the character used for decimal point is only defined once, the first symbol in the numbers line above, which is a `,`.
Am I wrong about something here?
Hmm that sounds about right, good find both of you, thanks!

body: Actually the correct format will be `€ 123.456.789,00` with the fix

How so? Isnt that another bug then? 
In locale de-AT there is a blank defined as digit grouping symbol?

It was previously using the currency group symbol instead of the currency decimal symbol. With the fix, it'll use the currency group symbol for group, and the regular number decimal symbol for decimals.

I see.
So am I correct that the last symbol of the following line:

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/637805a0c90b201f3e258eaeff967d5992d71faf/packages/common/locales/de-AT.ts#L54

is the digit grouping symbol used for currencies if it is defined? 
And if undefined it will fallback to the 2nd symbol of this line, the digit grouping symbol for decimals.

E.g. in the locales/de.ts file this last symbol is undefined, which means same symbol for decimals as for currencies?
Yes that is how the formatting rules are defined by CLDR, use the currency specific symbols if they are defined, or use the regular symbols otherwise.
